Command.title: Command and allies
Command.unavailable: This action is unavailable. Check the source, target, declarations and resources.
Command.beast: The GM confirms an eligible nonhuman beast (not an alien, extradimensional being, very intelligent creature or robot).
Command.inRange: The target is within short range.
Command.sootheHint: Make a non-damaging Intellect attack (2 Intellect). Calm lasts until your ten-minute or longer recovery. Calm does not itself make the beast friendly.
Command.lightingHint: Use a Last action to command an ally or follower. Their next action becomes First; a Last action becomes ordinary. Renewed by a ten-minute or longer recovery. In managed combat, declare a Last action in the round plan so it uses an ordinary slot.
Command.ally: The GM confirms this target is an ally or follower.
Command.teamUpHint: Bind an existing level-4 superhero NPC. Agree its Origin power adaptation and task modifications with the GM. It stays level 4. Each outing requires availability and a difficulty-2 charm task.
Command.tasks: Declared task modifications (one per line: task = level)
Command.maintainHint: Spend your action to continue calming without paying Intellect again. Keep using an action each turn beyond recovery. Outside combat, the GM explicitly ends maintenance when interrupted.
Command.available: The GM confirms the ally is available for this outing.
Command.outingHint: Make a difficulty-2 Intellect charm task. Success allows the ally to accompany you for this outing. End it explicitly when finished; an older reroll cannot reopen it.
Command.allyHint: Team-Up ally: manage its outing above.
Command.care: For a Team-Up ally: the GM confirms several weeks of arranged or provided care; enter that duration and its source.
